title: finding(console): `FormPage` degrades an unregistered `widget` to a text input, where the spec declares it degrades to the field's `type` renderer
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a declared contract the renderer breaches (class b). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it. The site is `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` `resolveFieldWidgetKey`: its `widget` leg returns `resolveFormWidgetType(field.widget)`, whose answer for an unknown spelling is `text`.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10176 (PR objectui#10469). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## The contract

The spec's `FieldSchema.widget` describe, in the installed 17.4.0 and on objectstack `main`: 「Form widget override — names a registered field component (resolved as `field:<widget>`) to render this field instead of the `type` default. Degrades to the `type` renderer when unregistered.」

## Reproduction (the dev's probe, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`FormPage` (internal route) with real widgets, on `main` at `808f33986`:
- An object field `{ type: 'select', options: [...], widget: 'no_such_widget' }` rendered `INPUT[id=f_sel, type=text]`, not the select.
- On form-view fields, `widget: 'field:owner'` (the spelling the tombstone's prescription names as retired) rendered a working `INPUT[type=text]`, and `widget: 'field:textarea'` rendered a single-line `INPUT[type=text]`.

Not measured: whether the record form (`form.tsx`) does the same, and whether a `field:`-qualified spelling is authorable on a form view at all. The `FormView` field `widget` describe says only "Custom widget/component name (overrides type-based inference)".

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- Seam: `spec:FieldSchema.widget` → `renderer:apps/console FormPage resolveFieldWidgetKey`.
- The shape of the fix: an unregistered `widget` falls through to the `type` leg of the same resolver. ⛔ Not a local list of known widgets.
- Sibling of the tombstone-spelling finding filed from the same report, which is a different site in `@object-ui/fields`.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). "Degrades to the `type` renderer" ⇒ 0. `resolveFieldWidgetKey` ⇒ only objectui#10457 (which introduced it) and PR objectui#10469. `unregistered` near `widget` ⇒ six hits, none about this degrade path. Must-hit control `tombstone` ⇒ 59 hits.

Dedupe words: `FormPage unregistered widget degrades to text not type` · `widget field:owner FormPage text input` · `resolveFieldWidgetKey widget fallback type renderer`
